scorecard_source: Bandon Dunes Golf Resort, Bandon Trails scorecard 2026 (resort website image Website-Trails-Scorecard-2026.jpg, GitHub release bandon-trails-data), read 2026-10-20. Every row adds up to the printed Out/In/Total. Men's ratings/slopes: Black 74.9/136, Green 72.0/137, Gold 69.6/132, Royal Blue 63.0/113, Orange 66.6/125. The card has no Blue; Green (6,249 yd) is the set closest to 6,300 yd (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1).
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-10-20: Green tees; all water red, including Round Lake (w266664506, a lateral water hazard just outside the boundary beside hole 7) via red_water_osm; Fahys Lake (w266664497, 108 m from hole 13, outside the boundary, untagged) stays out of bounds; Round Lake Drive inside the boundary plays as a cart path; pnw theme; open-coast wind 3-14 mph.
